svg.text: Calibration card v1: millimetre scale, viewing angle and colour drift
Print check: this line is 100 mm
1. Print at 100% (“Actual size”). Turn off “Fit to page” and any scaling.
2. Check the print: the line above must measure exactly 100 mm. Argus asks for this number during setup.
3. Cut along the dashed outline. Glue the card onto stiff cardboard so it stays flat. Plain matte paper, not glossy.
4. Place the card in the same plane as what you measure (for jars: level with the front walls), facing the camera.
5. Standard card: desk and top-down views. Compact card: beside jars in a side view. Keep one card fully in frame.
ArUco DICT_4X4_50 · standard IDs 0–3 (20 mm) · compact IDs 4–7 (14 mm) · github.com/aymenawel/Argus
